correctness.rationale: A word with ones closes by appending zero or one zero as dictated by its exterior parity, while the all-zero cylinder contains a fixed point. For n even the single-one witness and for n odd the leading-two-ones witness are unbordered with odd exterior parity, ruling out periods below n by the border condition and period n by the wrap gap. The marker construction has length 2L+7 plus the total odd-part length, correct internal gaps and odd exterior parity. Borders of lengths 1–3 fail the explicit endpoints; lengths 4 through 2L+2 have prefix ending 00 and suffix ending 10; longer proper borders would recur the unique 110^(2L)1 marker. Gap parsing is injective. The odd-part composition generating function has a simple positive dominant pole and no other pole of the same modulus (part 1 enforces zero phase in equality in the triangle inequality). Fixing L gives the lower exponential bound at every sufficiently large n; the roots then tend to the golden-ratio root of the infinite odd-part sum. The two-state even-shift graph counts every word with a one exactly once, and counts the all-zero word twice, yielding F_(n+3)−1 for the matching upper bound. This proves a growth rate, not density by itself. Independent verification reconstructed indexed cylinders by closed labelled graph walks, treating the zero fixed point separately, and found Q_2 through Q_14 equal to 2,2,4,4,8,10,18,24,42,62,104,158,262; it also checked all 1,960 specified sampled marker words by direct border and parity tests.
residual_risks: The reproduction is finite; the proof of the growth rate is analytic. No formal verification or expert attestation.

value.rationale: The worst-case closing statistic on this standard strictly sofic system is well motivated, and the explicit marker families give a valid alternate proof. As submitted, however, the exact maximum and the entropy exponent are weaker consequences of a checked covering argument that gives the full recurrence and positive density. The frozen finding does not establish a separate classification or substantively stronger conclusion specific to the marker method; the alternate proof alone is insufficient under the value criterion for a narrow covered invariant.
residual_risks: The frozen result itself proves neither an exact count nor a positive density; the stronger conclusions cited in the originality decision come from the separate comparison.
